title: Service Item
description: A service entry in the station's service catalog with pricing information

priceCreditsPerMinute.description: Price in credits per minute (applicable when pricingType is PerMinute)

priceCreditsFixed.description: Fixed price in credits (applicable when pricingType is fixed)

priceLocalPerMinute.description: Optional price in local-currency minor units per minute

priceLocalFixed.description: Optional fixed price in local-currency minor units

available.description: Whether this service is currently available for use

bindings.description: Where this commercial service physically runs: one entry per (bay, program) pair it is bound to. The binding is created on the SERVER by an operator (Chapter 01 — Architecture §4.2); the station never originates it and only receives it here. This is what lets the station act OFFLINE, where no StartService command exists to carry the ordinal — BLE start requests name a serviceId, and this is the only mapping from that to a physical program. One program MAY carry several services, so two catalog entries MAY name the same (bayNumber, programNumber); the reverse is also allowed — one service bound to the same program on several bays.

bayNumber.description: The bay this binding applies to, as the station declared it.

programNumber.description: The program on that bay which this service runs.
